title: Zverev cruises past De Minaur to reach Shanghai semifinals
description: Majid Majidi’s ‘Midday Meal’ won the top award at the Busan International Film Festival, securing a spot in the Oscars’ international feature category. The festival is the largest in Asia and featured 13 contenders this year.

title: Iran’s military says oil tanker on fire in Gulf of Oman
description: An oil tanker has caught fire in the Gulf of Oman while attempting to navigate a restricted area, according to Iran’s military.

title: Two ships ablaze off Romanian Black Sea coast, 7 sailors missing
description: BUCHAREST: Rescuers were searching for seven missing crew on Thursday from one of two chemical tankers that caught fire overnight just outside Romanian territorial waters in the Black Sea, after Russian drones strayed into national airspace, Romanian officials said. title: Charity withholds report into its role in disappearances of Syrian children: BBC
description: LONDON: A report into the role of a charity in the removal and disappearance of Syrian children during the country’s civil war will not be released, the BBC reported. SOS Children’s Villages International commissioned the report but is withholding its findings and has yet to pay compensation to families affected by the nationwide state-backed detentions of parents and the removal of their children. title: Palestinian prisoners shot at close range in Israeli detention, rights groups say
description: LONDON: Prison guards shot Palestinian detainees at close range and inside their cells in Israeli detention facilities, causing injuries that in some cases required surgery, according to accounts collected by two Israeli human rights groups. description: JEDDAH: The last thing Lamis Asiri’s father sent her before the Oct. 10 attack on King Khalid International Airport was a simple wish for a safe journey home. Hours later, the WhatsApp conversation that had connected them fell silent. Lamis, a final-year student at Prince Musaid bin Abdulrahman University in Abha, had traveled to Riyadh with her mother for a medical appointment. title: Iran’s president says US blockade aims to spark protests
description: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian accuses the United States of imposing the most severe blockade since the 1979 Islamic Revolution, aiming to provoke public protests. Tensions escalated after recent US and Israeli strikes in Iran.

title: Coalition: Houthis attacked King Khalid International Airport 20 times so far this month
description: RIYADH: The Houthi militia in Yemen has carried out 20 attacks on King Khalid International Airport since the start of the month, the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen said on Thursday. At least 17 people have died and more than 330 have been injured in the attacks on the airport in Riyadh, spokesperson Maj. Gen. title: Ukraine’s Zelensky defies Trump with Russian refinery strikes
description: President Zelensky of Ukraine has decided to ignore President Trump’s demand not to target Russian oil refineries, highlighting growing tensions between the two countries over a recent US-Russia diesel deal.

description: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer (D-N.Y.) is on the cusp of leading his party to midterm victory and reclaiming his title as Senate majority leader.Winning the majority isn't guaranteed. description: The future of war is in outer space — and the U.S. is unprepared for the fallout.Why it matters: An outbreak of space warfare would cripple the global economy by disrupting satellites used for everything from worldwide financial transactions to maritime navigation. title: Lockheed eyes fresh PAC-3 interceptor production options for Ukraine, Europe
description: “If we were to go forward with exploring any kind of production in Germany, we would likely do that with a company like Diehl,” a Lockheed executive said.

title: Kongsberg to build new plant in Poland for counter-drone systems
description: Norway’s Kongsberg has decided to build a new production facility for counter-drone systems in northern Poland.

title: 'American abandonment' threatens Ukraine's civilians in war against Russia
description: PRESS REVIEW – Thursday, October 15: First, reported Starlink disruptions in Ukraine make the European front pages. Next, US papers go into more detail about the situation. Also, an unusual alliance forms in Germany between far-right and far-left parties. Meanwhile, the winners of the Wildlife Photographer of the Year awards have been announced. Finally, Finland flaunts its smelly islands.

description: François Picard is pleased to welcome Siow-Ming Lee, Professor of Medical Oncology at the University College London and a specialist in lung cancer. “Lung cancer is not one cancer. There are many different types of lung cancer,” explains Lee. For decades, lung cancer has been closely associated with smoking, late diagnosis and poor survival prospects. title: Elon Musk and Donald Trump: What their growing ties mean for Ukraine
description: The recent disruption of SpaceX’s Starlink satellite internet service in Ukraine comes as Washington steps up pressure on Kyiv to halt its strikes on Russian oil refineries. The system plays a key role in Ukraine’s long-range drone operations, raising questions about the implications of the disruption and Elon Musk’s increasingly close ties with Donald Trump.
